# The Old Springs

*Mabbu remembers every spring that ran in the driest year. Check three old springs on the Dry Hills and hunt 80 Swollen Stumps there.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Story |
| Given by | [Mabbu](../npcs/mabbu_tolmach.md) |
| Level | 52 |
| After | [Tell Your Mother](../quests/ennek_tell_your_mother.md) |
| Leads to | [A Shimmering Night](../quests/imre_a_shimmering_night.md) |

## Objectives

1. Look at the spring under the split rock in [The Dry Hills](../maps/dry_hills.md)
2. Look at the spring in the white hollow in [The Dry Hills](../maps/dry_hills.md)
3. Look at the spring at the foot of the long bank in [The Dry Hills](../maps/dry_hills.md)
4. Defeat 80 [Swollen Stump](../monsters/swollen_stump.md) in [The Dry Hills](../maps/dry_hills.md)

## Rewards

- 86,000 EXP
- 1,040 mesos
- [Rimwort Tonic](../items/rimwort_tonic.md) x5
- [Highland Salve](../items/highland_salve.md) x5
- +40 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Mabbu](../npcs/mabbu_tolmach.md)
